run_pipeline_example: run the spdl pipeline example that merges two sub-pipelines and processes items through cache-aware routing
create_sub_pipeline_1: create a sub-pipeline configuration that squares numbers from range 0-4 and aggregates them into batches of 2
create_sub_pipeline_2: create a sub-pipeline configuration that adds 100 to numbers from range 10-14 with concurrency 2
create_main_pipeline: create a main pipeline that merges two sub-pipelines and routes items through cache-based PathVariants
build_pipeline_with_merge: build an spdl pipeline using Merge to combine outputs from multiple sub-pipelines into a single stream
